title: LVMH Media Division partners with OpenAI to bring publications to ChatGPT
dek: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a collaboration to support journalism with AI and increase accessibility of LVMH publications through ChatGPT.
body:
LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a strategic partnership to support journalism with AI and to make LVMH’s publications more accessible through ChatGPT. The announcement frames the collaboration around journalistic support and accessibility via OpenAI’s conversational platform.

## Why it matters
This is a direct tie between a major luxury-group media arm and an AI platform with a broad user base. The stated aims,supporting journalism with AI and increasing accessibility of publications through ChatGPT—touch on three core industry levers: content creation and distribution, audience reach, and how publishers use AI tools.

The announcement itself is the only confirmed fact; other operational and commercial details are not provided in the statement.

## The details
- Parties: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announced the partnership.
- Purpose: The collaboration is described as intended to support journalism with AI.
- Distribution: The partnership aims to make LVMH’s publications more accessible through ChatGPT, OpenAI’s conversational AI product.
- Unknowns: The announcement does not include scope, timeline, financial terms, specific products or features to be used, or how editorial control and content moderation will be handled.

## What to watch
Watch for follow-up announcements that provide scope and timing for integration into ChatGPT, and any details on commercial terms or product features. Also look for clarifications on editorial workflows, data sharing, and how accessibility will be measured or implemented.

Source: reporting by OpenAI.
